title: Inside the "Black Box" of Sell-Side Financial Analysts

scopes.description: The assigned release is an online appendix with aggregate survey results, cross-sectional regression tables, and the survey instrument. The complete paper-wide author workflow, respondent-level inputs, and program/output map are unknown from this document-only material.

requirements.description: Author-prepared respondent-level data and input specifications needed to reproduce the appendix cross-sectional survey analyses, plus the complete paper-wide analysis inputs; the supplied appendix reports aggregate results and does not establish a compatible input route.

issues.description: No author program or executable workflow is supplied in this release; its assigned inventory contains only the online-appendix PDF.

The appendix contains supplementary survey results, cross-sectional analyses, and a survey instrument, but does not specify the complete paper-wide workflow, all analysis inputs, sample construction, entry points, or full output map. These requirements cannot be inferred from this document-only release.

evidence.description: The assigned work-item inventory lists one material file, brown-call-clement-sharp-online-appendix.pdf, and no dependency edges; the static audit reports only that PDF and no supported code.
The supplied PDF identifies itself as the online appendix to the titled paper.
The appendix contents identify demographic/survey responses, cross-sectional results, and the survey instrument as its contents.
evidence.quote: Cross-Sectional Results for Brown, Call, Clement, and Sharp (2015)

evidence.description: An appendix results table reports regression output for survey responses, confirming that the PDF presents reported analytical results rather than the executable analysis inputs.
evidence.quote: The dependent variable is the analyst’s response to the survey question, ranging from 0 to 6.

evidence.description: The appendix includes the survey instrument and describes its question count; the instrument is not respondent-level analysis data.
evidence.quote: The survey has 14 questions and asks for basic demographic information at the end.

actions.description: Obtain the complete author replication materials and specifications before defining or attempting the full paper replication scope.
steps: Request the complete paper-wide author release, including programs and all entry points, README or data documentation, author-prepared respondent-level analysis data, and required software/version notes.
Request the authors’ mapping from each paper and appendix table/figure to its program, required inputs, generated intermediates, and execution order.

After receipt, inspect the author-prepared data fields, identifiers, period, transformations, and coverage against the specified analyses; do not treat the published aggregate tables or survey instrument as microdata.
validation: Confirm the supplied release includes the author programs and an entry point for every documented output, or obtain an explicit author statement describing approved non-code alternatives.
Verify every required survey-analysis input against the author documentation and assess whether it covers all appendix and paper results before assigning route and readiness outcomes.
Only after workflow and inputs are fully specified, prepare a future authorized run plan and verify output coverage against the paper and online appendix.

review_notes: Assessment is limited to the assigned online-appendix PDF. It reports aggregate results and includes the survey instrument; neither supplies respondent-level analysis data or a runnable program.

No analysis_only scope is justified: the release supplies no author analysis code or respondent-level analysis input with a supported compatible route. The paper-wide scope remains explicitly unknown.
